release_notes:
v1.1.1 Release - Minor bug fixes and user experience improvements.

Changes:
  - Warning Throttling: Grouped similar Waveshare CAN mismatch warnings to avoid UI/log console spamming.
  - Bug Reporter: Fixed an infinite loop in description truncation logic during crash reports.
  - User Manual: Redesigned the offline manual with sidebar navigation, active scroll-spy, code snippet copying, and instant live search.
  - Installer: Fixed a split-installation guard bug in the Inno Setup script.
